title: Per-tenant degradation signature correlator and soft-fail dashboard
creator: Aisha Kumar
description:
Background: We currently have token-level SLIs and regional circuit dashboards but lack a way to correlate per-tenant degradation signatures across golden signals (latency, errors, saturation) and to stage 'soft-fail' visualizations that show progressive service degradation before hard failover. This makes it hard to tune admission and circuit-breaker hysteresis per-customer and to validate multi-region failover rehearsals.

Goal: Build an observability prototype that correlates token-latency deltas, admit rates, and error spike fingerprints at the tenant level and surfaces a soft-fail dashboard to help SREs and product engineers: (1) identify tenants likely to trigger circuit breakers, (2) visualize progressive degradation pattern templates, and (3) recommend adaptive backpressure knobs per-tenant.

Scope:
- Instrument a tenant-focused aggregation pipeline that joins sampled token-latency SLIs with admit-score histograms, KV-cache hit ratios, and regional fanout counts.
- Define a compact "degradation signature" vector (delta-p99-latency, p95-admit-rate-drop, error-rate-spike, kv-hit-delta, fanout-increase) and store on a recent-24h rolling window.
- Build a Grafana/Console dashboard with: tenant list view (sortable by risk-score), timeline heatmap of signatures, example trace links, and a progressive soft-fail simulator panel to replay signature templates.
- Wire outputs to the SLO runbook to suggest temporary circuit parameter tweaks and safe rollback ranges.

SLI/Metric definitions: (used for correlation)
- token_p99_latency_ms_sampled_by_tenant: sampled p99 over 1m windows (approx 1% sampling).
- tenant_admit_rate_p95: 5m aggregated admit ratio percentile per tenant.
- token_error_spike_rate: proportion of requests with non-200 or generation-failures in 1m windows.
- kv_cache_hit_ratio_delta: delta between 1h and 5m KV-hit ratios.
- regional_fanout_multiplier: ratio of average downstream fanout in region vs baseline.

Degradation signature composition: compress the raw metrics into normalized deltas and compute a weighted "degradation_risk_score" (stringent default weights but configurable per-tenant). The score will be used to triage dashboard ordering and to trigger synthetic prober runs.

Dashboard panels and UX:
- Tenant roster panel: risk_score, current SLO burn, recent p99 delta, last synthetic probe result, linked runbook snippets.
- Signature timeline heatmap: horizontal tenant rows, time buckets colored by signature cluster.
- Signature cluster detail: show example traces (trace IDs), admit-score distributions, and suggested admission scale factors.
- Soft-fail simulator: slider for risk_score threshold that overlays simulated partial circuit (degraded CPU/GPU/kv) and shows projected p99 and admit curves.
- Investigations panel: suggested next-steps and relevant PRs/Confluence pages.

Acceptance criteria:
1) Prototype pipeline runs on canary telemetry and produces degradation_signature rows for at least 100 tenants over 24h.
2) Dashboard displays tenant roster and timeline heatmap with drilldowns to traces.
3) Risk score correlates with at least one historical incident derived from the incident runbook sampling (precision > 0.6 for top 20 flagged tenants).
4) SREs can run the soft-fail simulator and see expected changes in p99 and admit-rate curves.

Technical approach:
- Telemetry: Extend sampling agent to emit tenant_id tags and lightweight token-latency bucket histograms (1ms bins up to 2s). Use existing eBPF collector for low-overhead timing where available.
- Aggregation: Use our metrics pipeline (Prometheus push/gateway or Loki-like append) to compute rolling quantiles and deltas. Persist signature vectors in a short-lived timeseries index (24–72h TTL) for dashboarding.
- Dashboarding: Implement panels in Console -> Observability (Grafana-compatible) using pre-aggregated queries to avoid burst QPS. Soft-fail simulator will be a client-side JS widget that consumes signature vectors and applies heuristics to project curves.
- Safety: Ensure sampled traces do not contain PII; follow redaction rules and KMS access for trace links.

Risks and mitigations:
- Risk: High cardinality (many tenants) -> mitigation: cap roster to tenants above a usage threshold and use reservoir sampling for low-volume tenants.
- Risk: False positives due to noise -> mitigation: require multi-signal concordance and historical persistence (>10m) before high-risk flag.
- Risk: Dashboard query cost -> mitigation: aggressive downsampling, precompute risk scores in batch job.

Rollout plan:
1) Prototype in staging using synthetic tenant traffic (2 weeks).
2) Canary with 50 production tenants (1 week) and measure precision/recall against known incidents.
3) Gradual rollout to top 500 tenants with guardrails and opt-out.
